No bug that makes the result meaningless. One small redundancy: 'heavy' counts atoms whose symbol is not 'H'. Without AddHs, mol.GetAtoms() already leaves out implicit hydrogens, so this equals the total atom count. That is harmless.
Recomputed z = (0.1047 - 0.1088) / (0.0049 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = -0.0041 / 0.0060 ≈ -0.68. This matches the harness value of -0.673; the small gap comes from rounding of the means.
The candidate is worse than the incumbent (0.1088 vs 0.1047), but only by less than one standard error. Rejecting it is consistent with the numbers.
